issues.description: SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) has conflicting return types: the problem statement/UML requires `double` (and explicitly mentions double precision for financial calculations), but the reference solution implements it as `public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)`. This inconsistency can cause student submissions to fail signature-based checks or confuse them about the expected numeric type.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the reference solution (and expected student API) with the specification by changing the method signature to `public static double calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)` and returning a `double` total (e.g., accumulate into a `double` or cast the sum on return).
